items.heading: We Ordered the Lanes
items.text: We ordered the lanes by how far income and responsibility can scale, not by prestige. Consulting and product lead because pay and scope can compound fastest. Ownership sits last because it has no placement route at all.

rows: Top IIMs and a handful of elite institutes
IIM Calcutta 2026: average Rs 36 LPA, median Rs 35 LPA, 458 students, 542 offers, 202 recruiters. IIM Bangalore 2024-26: average Rs 35.35 LPA.
Consulting, finance, product, general management, FMCG brand roles. Almost every lane above is open on day one.

Careers360 puts the average at Rs 10-20 LPA for the tier. One undated listing shows fees of Rs 14-24 lakh against averages of Rs 9-19 LPA, so fee is often 1.3 to 1.9 times a year of average pay (table below).
BFSI relationship and credit roles, sales and business development, HR generalist, operations, analyst roles at services firms. Consulting and product open later.

In NIRF 2022 data (2020-21 batch), 29 of the top 100 management institutes reported a median salary below Rs 6 lakh, and those 29 placed only 67.7% of graduates (4,199 of 6,202). The data is old and pandemic-affected, so treat it as a warning, not a forecast.
Sales, tele-banking, insurance, collections, and back-office roles. Real progress comes from a skill layer and job switches, not from the degree.
